epochs.cause: The floor model's provider key moves out of the run container into a key proxy beside the egress proxy (lane F7, brought forward): a floor run gets a placeholder key and the proxy's base URL, its runner calls the proxy, and its web cases run on the eval's own open network; the strong tier's runs are unchanged.
The strong model's credential moves out of the run container into a key proxy of its own, and the floor model's calls are pinned to one upstream provider by its key proxy.

SEC and P2b: a held run reaches only its own key proxy; the key proxy drops credential headers and forwards only the model endpoints; P2b adds a key proxy per run and model, metering and the platform per line (one epoch for both)

Pre-battery: the claude runner 2.1.284 knows the reference model, PDF tools in the image, the adapters report every tool that reads a skill's SKILL.md (skills_loaded) or touches its folder (skills_used) (R12), a loop of raw tool-call syntax is an early end even when a file was written (T27), and staging leaves a dangling link out of a skill folder it copies (it raised on Python 3.9)
